title: SendUnitData connected-item encapsulation seed
purpose: Add connected-data encapsulation coverage with the documented Connected Address Item plus Connected Data Item combination, distinct from the unconnected SendRRData path.
expected_behavior: A parser should accept the encapsulation header and CPF layout for SendUnitData, then parse a Connected Address Item carrying a 4-byte connection identifier and a Connected Data Item carrying 6 bytes of data. Because no real ForwardOpen-established connection is implied, higher-layer acceptance may fail normally after framing succeeds.
constraints_preserved: 24-byte encapsulation header used with Length 0x0016 matching 22 CPF bytes.
CPF item count is 2, using the documented common SendUnitData combination: Connected Address Item type 0x0100 length 4, then Connected Data Item type 0x00B1 length 6.

Connected Address Item data is a 4-byte placeholder connection identifier; Connected Data Item begins with a 2-byte sequence-style value followed by payload bytes as a conservative connected-data shape.
Marked standalone because a real connected exchange would require prior connection establishment not supplied by the source material.
issue_safety_notes: This seed is not derived from the historical crash path. It broadens parser coverage into connected CPF handling while remaining fully length-consistent and independent of malformed ForwardOpen parsing.
